operations.description: Tenant sessions are restricted to their own scope and facts where they are the actor or subject. Platform sessions require platform.admin and one explicit target_scope_id. Platform automation may capture a signed opaque audit boundary, then query an exact actor after that boundary without exposing stream positions; notification facts cannot be mixed into boundary queries.

params.name: audit_boundary
params.description: Capture a signed target-scope audit head. Must be used alone with target_scope_id by a platform administrator.

params.name: after_audit_boundary
params.description: Signed boundary returned by a prior capture. Must be paired with actor_user_id and resent unchanged on cursor pages.

params.name: actor_user_id
params.description: Exact browser actor for platform filtering. A signed-boundary query must pair this parameter with after_audit_boundary; subject-only notification matching is not permitted in that mode.

fields.name: audit_boundary
fields.description: Signed opaque boundary; internal stream positions are never exposed.
